title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Report and physics source state conservative compressible NS, perfect-gas closure and nondimensionalization.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS unstructured zones, geometry and adjacency are implemented in mesh/partition modules.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Face-by-face conservative residual assembly is documented and source-evidenced.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov/local Lax-Friedrichs flux with viscous spectral augmentation is implemented; no richer entropy-stable flux.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Characteristic farfield, slip wall and no-slip adiabatic wall paths are described and implemented.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Least-squares piecewise-linear reconstruction is present, with documented startup first-order continuation.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Production Venkatakrishnan limiter and density/pressure positivity control are source-evidenced.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Newtonian/Fourier viscous terms, gradients and tangential skin-friction reporting are evidenced in source and report.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Nonlinear LU-SGS defect correction with local pseudo-time/CFL controls is source-evidenced.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: Re200 metadata reports BDF2 dual time, 30000 steps to t=300 and inner statistics; evaluated read-only, never rerun.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS ownership/ghost design is present, but submitted cylinder rank results show the disqualifying order-one rank dependence.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
